status: wavelength source is selectable (quality.WAVELENGTH_SOURCES); the default and every published number stay on legacy 'wcs'. This file says what would change on a switch.

explanation.cause: The cutout header holds two WCS. The celestial one is RA---TAN-SIP/DEC--TAN-SIP with SIP coefficients A_i_j, B_i_j, AP_i_j, BP_i_j. The SIP convention (Shupe et al. 2005) has no alternate-WCS letter for these keywords and ties them to a CTYPE ending in -SIP. The spectral WCS 'W' is CTYPEjW = WAVE-TAB (FITS Paper III -TAB, bilinear lookup) on raw 1-based parent pixel coordinates (CRPIXjW = CRPIXjA, CDELTjW = CRVALjW = 1); it has no -SIP. astropy.wcs.WCS(header, key='W') nevertheless calls _read_sip_kw(header, wcskey='W'), which reads the unsuffixed A_/B_ keywords and builds Sip(..., crpix=(CRPIX1W, CRPIX2W)); the CTYPE check only logs an INFO note (which quality.py silenced). pixel_to_world then looks the table up at p + SIP(p + 1 - CRPIXW): the celestial polynomial (incl. A_0_0, B_0_0 ~ -0.3/-1.1 px), evaluated around the wrong reference pixel (the parent origin instead of the celestial CRPIX), so the shift reaches tens of pixels near the detector edge.
explanation.proof: sip_proof below, all cached cutouts, 5x5 points each: nosip - table and legacy - table@sip agree to ~1e-12 um on every detector, i.e. astropy's -TAB read is exact and the SIP shift alone is the legacy offset.
explanation.is_wcs_nosip_equal_to_cwave: No. wcs_nosip is the 9x9 control-point table, which IRSA says is accurate to ~1 nm and meant for visualization; CWAVE/CBAND are the per-pixel maps. See sip_proof.*.cwave_minus_nosip_nm.

modes.cwave: CWAVE/CBAND of the Spectral WCS product at the parent pixel (IRSA: for science); falls back to wcs_nosip with a 'wavelength_fallback' warning if the map is missing

finding_sip_previous_wording: astropy applies the celestial SIP polynomial (A_*/B_* keywords, no alternate letter) to WCS(key='W'), so quality.py reads the WCS-WAVE table at a distorted pixel. 'table' below reads the same table without SIP; the difference table - production is that effect alone.
